news.titleEn: Stock futures tick lower after Dow closes below 50,000 for first time since June: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq each fell more than 2% on Thursday, with the Dow closing below 50,000 for the first time since June, and Asian markets followed lower.
news.conclusionZh: 美股三大指数均跌超2%，道指半年来首次跌破5万点
news.whyEn: The selloff extends the S&P 500's longest losing streak since 2024 and is spilling into Asia, pressuring retirement accounts, tech-heavy portfolios and global risk appetite.
news.whyZh: 标普连跌创2024年来最长纪录，抛售蔓延亚洲，科技股持仓和全球风险偏好承压
news.detailEn: Week to date, the Dow is down about 6.2% and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq about 5% each, as doubts about AI spending and expectations of a Fed rate hike weigh on stocks. Anthropic's strong debut failed to lift the broader AI trade, and a vendor cyberattack disclosed by JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard dented sentiment. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 4.5% after October core inflation hit 2.2%, raising the odds of a Bank of Japan hike next month to around 72%, while South Korea's Kospi dropped nearly 4% at the open. Some strategists say the market now looks oversold, but volatility is likely to stay high until the Fed's Dec. 8-9 meeting.
news.detailZh: 本周以来道指累计跌约6.2%，标普和纳指各跌约5%，市场担心AI投资难以为继，同时押注美联储12月加息。Anthropic上市首日表现强劲也没能带动AI板块，摩根大通、Visa、万事达披露供应商遭网络攻击又进一步打压情绪。亚洲方面，日本10月核心通胀升至2.2%，日经225指数大跌4.5%，市场认为日本央行下月加息概率约72%；韩国Kospi开盘跌近4%。有策略师认为市场已经超卖，但在美联储12月8-9日会议前波动可能仍会很大。

news.titleEn: Live updates: Anthropic's record-setting IPO can't halt broader market slide
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic shares opened around $111.50 and closed their first trading day at $97.17, about 17% above the $83 IPO price.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic上市首日收涨约17%，报97.17美元
news.whyEn: The largest IPO on record is a key test of public-market appetite for AI companies and sets a valuation benchmark for rivals such as OpenAI.
news.whyZh: 史上最大IPO是检验公开市场对AI公司胃口的关键，也为同行估值定了标杆
news.detailEn: The stock gave back much of its early pop, trading well below its intraday high near $115 as the broader market fell more than 2%. Valuation estimates vary by share count, with NBC citing roughly $1.76 trillion at the close including restricted shares and options. Employees can sell 10% of their shares on day one, and NBC estimates the IPO creates around 600 new centimillionaires. How the stock trades in coming weeks, and when lock-up restrictions end, will shape sentiment toward other AI listings.
news.detailZh: 股价开盘冲高后回落不少，在大盘跌超2%的背景下明显低于盘中约115美元的高点。由于统计口径不同，估值说法不一，NBC称按收盘价计算、包含限制性股票和期权的完全稀释估值约1.76万亿美元。员工上市首日可出售10%的持股，NBC估计这次IPO将造就约600位资产过亿美元的新富豪。未来几周的股价表现以及锁定期何时结束，将影响市场对其他AI公司上市的态度。

news.titleEn: 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit
news.conclusionEn: Trump, Xi and Putin held their first-ever three-way meeting in Shenzhen and issued a "peace declaration" that left out both the Ukraine war and the US-led war in Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 中美俄领导人深圳首次三方会晤，宣言未提乌克兰和伊朗战事
news.whyEn: A meeting of the three largest nuclear powers matters for oil, trade and security, but the lack of concrete deals limits its immediate market impact.
news.whyZh: 三大核大国会晤关系油价、贸易和安全，但缺乏具体协议，对市场的直接影响有限
news.detailEn: The talks, held on the sidelines of APEC, lasted just over an hour after separate bilateral meetings. The joint declaration covered UN reform, more oil supply and nuclear risk, but AP found no sign Trump secured help from Xi or Putin on ending the Iran conflict. Trump said he and Xi agree Iran must fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz and cannot obtain a nuclear weapon. Afterwards he dialed into a Berlin meeting with more than 40 European leaders, some of whom criticized his warm greeting of Putin.
news.detailZh: 会晤在APEC期间举行，此前三人先分别进行了双边会谈，三方会谈持续一个多小时。联合宣言涉及联合国改革、增加石油供应和核风险，但美联社认为没看到特朗普在结束伊朗冲突上获得中俄任何承诺。特朗普称他和习近平都认为伊朗必须全面重开霍尔木兹海峡、不能拥有核武器。会后他视频参加了在柏林举行的40多位欧洲领导人会议，部分欧洲议员批评他对普京态度过于热情。

news.titleEn: Oil settles flat as Hormuz disruptions offset global surplus fears
news.conclusionEn: Brent settled at $91.98 and WTI at $83.21, its lowest since late August, as tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz offset rising US crude supply.
news.conclusionZh: 油价持平，WTI收于8月下旬以来最低
news.whyEn: Oil prices feed directly into inflation, central bank decisions and costs for airlines, shippers and consumers worldwide.
news.whyZh: 油价直接影响通胀和央行决策，也关系航空、航运和消费者成本
news.detailEn: Iran's navy claimed two tankers hit mines in the strait, though Reuters could not verify this. The IEA estimates the Middle East conflict has cost 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 billion cubic metres of gas so far. Saudi exports rose and Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian refinery runs, keeping supply flows unusually fragmented. Traders are weighing near-term disruption risk against forecasts of a supply surplus next year.
news.detailZh: 伊朗海军称两艘油轮在海峡触雷，路透社未能独立核实。国际能源署估计，中东冲突至今已造成28亿桶石油和600亿立方米天然气的供应损失。沙特出口增加，同时乌克兰无人机袭击使俄罗斯炼厂加工量大降，全球供应格局异常分散。交易员一边担心短期断供风险，一边又在消化明年可能供过于求的预测。

news.titleEn: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
news.conclusionEn: Walmart beat quarterly revenue and earnings estimates and raised its full-year outlook, but shares slipped about 2% after hours.
news.conclusionZh: 沃尔玛财报超预期并上调全年指引，盘后股价仍小跌
news.whyEn: As the largest US retailer, Walmart is a bellwether for consumer spending heading into the holiday season amid high fuel costs.
news.whyZh: 沃尔玛是美国消费风向标，可看出高油价下假日季消费的强弱
news.detailEn: Revenue reached $188.84 billion versus $187.27 billion expected, and adjusted EPS was 65 cents versus 64 cents. Global e-commerce sales rose 17% and Walmart U.S. advertising sales jumped 37%, while Sam's Club net sales grew 10%. The company raised full-year net sales growth guidance to 4.9%-5.2% and adjusted EPS guidance to $2.84-$2.89. Net income fell from a year earlier, and the CEO said the retailer will try to absorb soaring fuel costs rather than pass them all on to shoppers.
news.detailZh: 营收1888.4亿美元，高于预期的1872.7亿美元；调整后每股收益65美分，略高于预期的64美分。全球电商销售增长17%，美国广告业务增长37%，山姆会员店销售增长10%。公司将全年净销售增速指引上调至4.9%-5.2%，调整后每股收益指引上调至2.84-2.89美元。不过净利润同比下降，CEO表示会尽量自己消化飙升的燃油成本，不全部转嫁给顾客。

news.titleEn: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard disclose cyberattack on third-party vendors
news.conclusionEn: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard said outside vendors were hacked, exposing some customer names and email addresses but no card or payment data.
news.conclusionZh: 摩根大通、Visa、万事达披露供应商遭黑客攻击，部分客户信息外泄
news.whyEn: It shows how third-party vendors are a weak link for big banks, and exposed customers now face a higher risk of targeted phishing.
news.whyZh: 暴露大银行的第三方供应商短板，受影响客户面临更高的钓鱼诈骗风险
news.detailEn: JPMorgan said attackers likely accessed marketing data held by vendors, Visa linked its incident to a provider in Asia-Pacific, and Mastercard said a subset of cardholders in one benefit program was affected. All three said their own systems and payment networks were not compromised. A ransomware group called n0n has claimed responsibility, though this has not been verified. Security experts warn customers to be wary of emails or calls impersonating their bank or card issuer.
news.detailZh: 摩根大通称攻击者可能获取了供应商保存的营销数据，Visa称事件源于亚太区一家服务商，万事达称受影响的是某个权益计划中的部分持卡人。三家公司都表示自身系统和支付网络没有受影响。一个名为n0n的勒索软件组织声称对此负责，但尚未得到证实。安全专家提醒客户警惕冒充银行或发卡机构的邮件和电话。

news.titleEn: World Court finds Myanmar responsible for Rohingya genocide in landmark ruling
news.conclusionEn: The International Court of Justice ruled 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first time it has found a state responsible for genocide.
news.conclusionZh: 国际法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人犯下种族灭绝罪，史上首例
news.whyEn: The precedent could shape other genocide cases, including those watched over Gaza, and raises reputational and sanctions risks for Myanmar.
news.whyZh: 此判例可能影响其他种族灭绝案件，包括外界关注的加沙相关案件
news.detailEn: The case was brought in 2019 by The Gambia over the 2017 military campaign that drove more than 730,000 Rohingya into Bangladesh. The court said security forces killed around 10,000 Rohingya and found Myanmar also failed to prevent and punish genocide. Myanmar must prosecute those responsible and compensate victims, with the amount to be set later. The ruling is final, but the court has no means of enforcing it.
news.detailZh: 此案由冈比亚于2019年提起，针对2017年缅甸军方的清剿行动，当时有73万多名罗兴亚人逃往孟加拉国。法院称缅甸安全部队杀害了约1万名罗兴亚人，并认定缅甸未能防止和惩治种族灭绝。缅甸须起诉相关责任人并赔偿受害者，赔偿金额日后再定。判决为终局裁决，但法院本身没有强制执行手段。

businessTips.explanationEn: Third-party risk management means identifying and controlling the risks that come from suppliers, contractors and software vendors who handle your data or operations. Your security is only as strong as the weakest partner with access to your systems or customer lists. Good practice includes vetting vendors before signing, sharing only the data they truly need, and writing breach-notification duties into contracts.
businessTips.explanationZh: 第三方风险管理，就是识别并控制来自供应商、外包方和软件服务商的风险，因为他们会接触你的数据或参与你的运营。你的安全水平取决于能接触你系统或客户名单的最薄弱的那个合作方。常见做法包括签约前审核供应商、只给对方真正需要的数据，以及在合同里写明数据泄露后的通知义务。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard all had customer data exposed through outside vendors, even though their own systems were not hacked. A small business can apply the same lesson by keeping a simple list of every app that holds customer data and removing access for tools it no longer uses.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周摩根大通、Visa和万事达自身系统没被攻破，客户数据却通过外部供应商泄露了。小公司也能借鉴：列一张清单，记下所有存有客户数据的应用，把不再使用的工具的访问权限及时撤销。

businessTips.explanationEn: Abandoned cart recovery means following up with shoppers who added items to their cart but left without paying. Typically around seven in ten online carts are abandoned, so winning back even a small share is often cheaper than finding brand-new customers. Common tools are automated reminder emails, a small time-limited discount, and fixing friction such as surprise shipping fees.
businessTips.explanationZh: 弃购挽回，是指跟进那些把商品加入购物车却没付款就离开的顾客。网购中通常约七成购物车会被放弃，哪怕挽回一小部分，成本也往往比拉新客户低。常见做法是自动发送提醒邮件、给一个限时小折扣，以及解决运费突然增加这类让人放弃的问题。
businessTips.exampleEn: A Shopify side shop could send a reminder one hour after a cart is abandoned and a 10%-off code after 24 hours. With Black Friday traffic coming, setting this up now can lift holiday sales without extra ad spend.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家Shopify副业小店可以在顾客弃购1小时后发提醒邮件，24小时后再发一个9折优惠码。黑五流量马上到来，现在设置好这个流程，不用多花广告费就能提升假日季销量。

businessTips.explanationEn: A market is called oversold when prices have fallen so far and so fast that selling may be exhausted in the short term. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a common gauge that scores recent gains versus losses from 0 to 100, and a reading below 30 is usually labeled oversold. Oversold does not mean prices must bounce right away; they can stay oversold for a long time in a strong downtrend.
businessTips.explanationZh: 超卖是指价格在短时间内跌得太多太快，短期抛压可能已接近衰竭。相对强弱指数（RSI）是常用指标，用0到100衡量近期涨跌力度，通常低于30被视为超卖。但超卖不代表马上会反弹，在强烈的下跌趋势中，价格可以长时间维持超卖状态。
businessTips.exampleEn: After the S&P 500's six-day losing streak this week, some strategists called the market very oversold. A long-term investor might use that signal to add gradually in small amounts rather than going all in at once.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周标普500连跌六天后，有策略师认为市场已严重超卖。长期投资者可以把它当作参考信号，分批小额逐步买入，而不是一次性全仓抄底。
